summary: Round 7 hypotheses (08:25-08:55Z): no new mechanism is worth building before R8. Nothing triggers E10: no public notebook newer than 25 Sep 09:09Z or above 0.953, no successor signature on the LB (0.953->0.956 x2, ->0.955 x3 since 05:48Z), and P(trigger) is now ~5-10%. The focus premise is false: forkmid failed on three counts, not only power. ORIGINAL T9 needs a 44b6 FP, which a 6bba extension cannot supply. L3's lowrefine sensitivity flags 4 readmit-touching forks as adverse in the pooled 56 clips, whatever new clips are added. The only honest route is a fresh ext-only replication on a lowrefine lab build: P(pass) ~0.4, EV ~+2-4e-5 on private, cost 4-5 GPU-h + a builder change + a K3 slot. Do not run it. Two cheap plan items: pre-register the E10 finals pair as {successor copy, K2} (needs the user's OK), and say in advance that losing public silver (margin 13 ranks, ~8 ranks/h drift) triggers nothing.

findings.what: The premise 'forkmid failed ONLY on power' is false, so the 6bba extension cannot rescue it under any frozen gate. (a) ORIGINAL T9 (in force without the L3 OK) requires >= 1 removed FP on 44b6. 44b6 has 12 removed forks and 0 FP, and a 6bba extension cannot supply 44b6 FP. (b) ADDENDUM L3 has a lowrefine-sensitivity half that fails structurally on the pooled 56 clips. Four metric-ignored forks touch readmitted nodes: two are removed (6bba_786893ac mid 4.68 um, 6bba_f8ffd5e7 4.83 um) and two lie within 0.7 um of 4.5 (6bba_969618f6 4.29, 6bba_cdcfe533 4.21). Counted as adverse, they give removed_tp = 4 whatever new clips are added. The only honest route is a fresh replication: a gate frozen before the run, scored on the 78 clean 6bba clips ONLY (no pooling with exp60), run on the K2 stack with lowrefine ON so the sensitivity is measured instead of proxied. Pass would need removed TP 0, evaluable FP >= 3, div_J(arm) >= control, adj_edge delta >= -0.0002 and nodes unchanged. Power arithmetic: GT density of the other 6bba clips is ~1.7x the parents of the exp60 6bba bed (72,083 vs 36,724 one-out GT parents). The bed would give ~56 removals x 1/28 evaluable-FP rate = mean ~2.0; a negative binomial with the 1-event rate uncertainty gives P(>= 3) ~0.46, and P(0 TP removed) ~0.9, so P(pass) ~0.4. Value if it passes: lab pooled +0.00013 (div_J +0.0010 x 0.1; 39 of 40 removals are unevaluable), i.e. ~+0.0001 on private x P(transfer) ~0.5. EV ~ +2e-5 to +4e-5, about 0.2-0.35 ranks at 87 teams per 0.001. Costs: there is no lab kernel with lowrefine (builder change plus tests, ~2-3 agent-h); 2 shards take ~4-5 GPU-h (quota is not binding after the 26 Sep 00:00Z reset, ~30 h); K3 = K2 + forkmid then needs a build, a dummy, a slot and a 7.5 h hidden run. R3 would then accept K3 as F1 even at public -0.001, so F1 could display 0.953. It is also a second test of an already-failed mechanism (forking paths).

Did not transfer: the edge filter (+0.016 lab, 0 LB in probes 29/30), relink-off and float output; efpost belongs to the same 'trust in-sample net' class. Every other closure fails on sign or on a harm clause, not on sample size: K3b DeepCenter t*=0.30 (confirmation, plateau, 44b6 and precision all fail); forkblob (vetoed TP 1 : FP 6, below the 7.7 break-even; div_J 0.1290->0.1271); ANTIPAR (-0.00034); clip-boundary b4 (SELECTION 0.00000; 7 clips improve, 47 get worse); stitch (precision 0.20 vs 0.48 break-even); linefit w0.7 (-0.0031 on 44b6); tempfuse K4 (no honest bed, round 2). Leaf prune on x138 is the one closure where lab and LB agree in sign: lp30 +0.00083 with 51/56 clips improving, and P36's unrounded public is above #35's. It was closed by RULE (P36 info-only, f2, R4's +0.002 entry) and rechecked in round 4. The lab base had no lowrefine, and 95% of the pruned nodes are readmitted nodes that K2's lowrefine improves. findings.what: E10 finals gap: the rules do not say which file an E10 port displaces. By R4 a verbatim successor at public >= 0.956 has delta >= +0.002 vs K2, so it becomes F1. The F2 choice is unwritten: K2 or the twin. Proposal (pre-register now, before any trigger): if E10 fires, the pair is {successor copy, K2 #37} and the twin drops out. Reasons: the twin's hedge (insertion harm on private only) is worth ~+0.0002 of option value, while K2 hedges the larger risk that the successor over-fits the public embryo (29% of the test). K2's insertion transferred twice. The copy is a byte copy of a public notebook, so on private it ties with every copier (earlier submission wins); that matters only for rank inside its tie block, not for the score. A 'successor + insertion' non-copy build is optional only if the trigger fires before ~27 Sep 06:00Z. It must reuse the K2 insertion knobs and gates (safetail C01, FF/FD-style dummies); no new knobs.
